verdict.rationale: Pricing is a fair axis for a paid transcription API, but nothing in the evidence pack covers it. There is no per-minute or per-hour rate, no itemized add-on prices (e.g. diarization, Pro model, text polishing), and no cost-estimation endpoint. The docs cover only features, endpoints, and job lifecycle, so an agent cannot compute a job's cost before submitting it from this evidence.
